elevation.focus.description: Default focus ring: a surface gap and a 2 px ring, at least 3:1 on every surface.

elevation.focus-inset.description: Inside the element, for full-width rows and tabs where an outer ring would be clipped.

elevation.focus-danger.description: Focus on a field that has an error.

elevation.focus-inverse.description: Focus on inverse (dark in light mode) surfaces.

elevation.focus-halo.description: Soft halo. Decorative: always combine with a focus ring.

size.touch-target.description: 44 px. Minimum hit area for anything interactive on touch screens.
